feed_authority.note: Connect the user's existing site-library dataset before creating duplicate discovery storage. R001 Native Content is the commercial capture/rebuild seed; R002 Motion Primitives is a source-build control, not a replacement feed.

references.title: Native Content
references.description: Independent local reconstruction of the Native Content project-stream homepage. Commercial footage, Mux streams, proprietary bundles and site font files are deliberately not copied; geometry, section sequencing, navigation, scroll-state behavior and mobile menu are measured separately, with raw full-frame screenshot fidelity retained as an informational rights-exception metric.

provenance.note: Source footage/posters/font files and authored bundles are reference-only. Local backgrounds are independently generated CSS abstractions; only reproducible layout/interaction surfaces are eligible for verification.

references.title: Motion Primitives
references.description: MIT-licensed website code used as a deterministic source-import fidelity control. Live GitHub-runner capture is blocked by Vercel Security Checkpoint, so visual baseline is built from the exact pinned upstream source SHA.

provenance.note: MIT code is pinned. Third-party demo media is sanitized rather than copied; accepted-surface visual exclusions are explicit and bounded, and self-containment is tested independently.
